TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Docs parity tests block ghost CLI commands, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete synapse-ai release paths, and unsupported Windows install claims across README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, and WORKFLOW.

Docs parity tests require installer dry-run mapping, release workflow artifacts, checksum aggregation, tag/version guard, generated release notes, strict cargo audit warnings, and release smoke artifact naming to describe the same Linux/macOS release matrix.
